dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「分かってると思うけど、今週の金曜、土曜は
　学年末試験だからね。ちゃんとベンキョしな
　よ。赤点とったら、追試だからね」
dialogues.en:
"Don't forget, this Friday and Saturday will be the days of
the year-end examinations. Make sure you study hard for
them. Those who fail will have to take the supplementary
examinations."
dialogues.text:
"Don't forget, this Friday and Saturday will be the days of
the year-end examinations. Make sure you study hard for
them. Those who fail will have to take the supplementary
examinations."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そうそう。あたしの研究に協力してくれたら、
　無条件で１００点にしてあげるよ」
dialogues.en:
"That reminds me. For those who wish to help with my
research, you must score no less than 100 marks for these
exams."
dialogues.text:
"That reminds me. For those who wish to help with my
research, you must score no less than 100 marks for these
exams."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、暦先生が週番に合図を送り、ＨＲ
が終了する。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei assigned the weekly duties, then ended
Homeroom.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei assigned the weekly duties, then ended
Homeroom.

dialogues.jp: 殉職後の二階級特進と同じような気が……。
dialogues.en:
That's like those soldiers dying honourably in battle
getting several promotions...
dialogues.text:
That's like those soldiers dying honourably in battle
getting several promotions...

dialogues.jp:
まあ、とにかく、今はこれからどうするかを早
急に考えねば。
dialogues.en:
In any case, I have to think quickly about what I want to do
today.
dialogues.text:
In any case, I have to think quickly about what I want to do
today.

dialogues.jp: じきに、さくらのやつもここに来るだろう。
dialogues.en: Sakura's surely going to drop by soon.
dialogues.text: Sakura's surely going to drop by soon.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、せっかく再会したんだし、さりげなく校
門辺りで待っていてやってもいいのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Well, maybe since we've already had the requisite "tearful
reunion", maybe she'd just be waiting casually for me around
school...
dialogues.text:
Well, maybe since we've already had the requisite "tearful
reunion", maybe she'd just be waiting casually for me around
school...

dialogues.jp:
授業の最後に暦先生が、週末の学年末試験につ
いて注意を促した。
dialogues.en:
At the end of the lesson, Koyomi-sensei warned us of the
examinations to come at the end of the school week.
dialogues.text:
At the end of the lesson, Koyomi-sensei warned us of the
examinations to come at the end of the school week.

dialogues.jp:
赤点も嫌だが、協力すれば１００点が保障され
るという先生の研究も、十二分に嫌だよな。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't want to fail them, but it'd be even worse to get
100 marks and be forced into doing research with her...
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't want to fail them, but it'd be even worse to get
100 marks and be forced into doing research with her...
